@@info: Prefer translating in your browser? Fink edits messages/uk.json directly — no code or git:
This file is the offline alternative.
Keys that exist in <en> but not in <uk>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with uk translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/uk.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
Plurals — uk uses the forms: one, few, many, other. "other" is required.
(add "plural": "total" to count another input instead of {count}).
Inside a sentence, # is the number: "Read {count, plural, one {# band} other {# bands}}"
An exact number like "=0": "No bands" beats the forms above.
device_eq_target_hint: This device has more than one EQ. Device EQ, Read, Write and the limits on the band list are for the one picked here. Picking another reads nothing and leaves your bands as they are.
device_eq_target_hint_link: This device has more than one EQ, and uniPEQ edits the one picked here. Picking another reads it from the device into the band list, in place of your bands.
device_eq_target_absent: Not available in the device's current mode: {eqs}
device_eq_status_gone: {eq} isn't available in the device's current mode, so this is {own}.
device_eq_unwritten: The band list has changes the device doesn't have yet. Write them, or Read to drop them, before picking another EQ.
device_presets_hint: This device keeps its presets as a list you can add to, rename and delete from. Rename and Delete act on the preset Device EQ shows. A new preset starts flat, and the device switches to it.
device_presets_full: The device has no room for another.
device_presets_pick_first: Pick one of your presets under Device EQ first.
device_presets_last: The device keeps at least one preset.
device_presets_rename_body: The name is stored on the device, which may only take a short one in plain letters and digits.
device_presets_name_refused: The device can't store that name. Try a shorter one in plain letters and digits.
device_presets_delete_body: The preset is removed from {device} for good. The device may switch to another of its presets.
device_control_eq_off: The device doesn't apply its EQ with this {control} setting.
device_control_eq_off_hint: The device doesn't apply its EQ with this setting.
device_control_confirm_body: The device restarts to apply it, and the sound stops for a moment. This page connects to it again.
device_control_restarted: Changed {control}. The device restarted and is connected again.
device_control_restart_reconnect: Changed {control}. The device restarted; reconnect to carry on.
link_preamp_clips: This preamp may clip: the bands need {needed} dB or lower.
